text.autoconfig.brbe.title: Better Recipe Book Config
Shows which mod an item comes from, similar to Jade.
text.autoconfig.brbe.option.partialCraft: Don't hide recipes missing some materials
When "Only show craftable" is enabled, recipes missing some materials will not be hidden.
text.autoconfig.brbe.option.hideReiJeiOv: Hides REI/JEI overlays in inventory screens. Recipe/usage lookup (R/U keys) still works.
text.autoconfig.brbe.option.rbip.enableR: Aligns the vanilla recipe book tab groups with the creative mode inventory.
text.autoconfig.brbe.option.settingsButt: §eTip: §7If you disable either of these two options, use the mod menu to re-enable them.
text.autoconfig.brbe.option.scrolling.sc: When you reach the end of the book, wrap back and keep scrolling from the start (Like JEI)
text.autoconfig.brbe.option.scrolling.en: Enable Scrolling in the Recipe Book
text.autoconfig.brbe.option.alternativeR: Only show alternate's recipe on hover
Show the item in the alternatives list instead of their recipe so its easy to see
text.autoconfig.brbe.option.newRecipes.u: Requires world/server re-join to take effect
text.autoconfig.brbe.option.newRecipes.e: Enable the little bounce animation when you unlock a new item
text.autoconfig.brbe.option.showAllRecip: Show all unlocked recipes in survival recipe book
